object_description: rectangular workshop and trapezoidal forum linked below terrain
design_condition: The rectangular workshop is embedded along the slope edge and reserved in relation to the existing main building, while the trapezoidal forum forms a public center beside largely intact green space and new viewing areas.

positive.statement: The workshop is successfully embedded in the edge of the slope, with a restrained delivery solution.

position.rationale: Rectangular workshop footprint visibly follows the upper sloped edge and remains compact.

positive.statement: The idea of expanding the open space to create a second viewing point is convincing.

position.rationale: Lower trapezoidal public element plausibly marks the expanded open-space viewing area.

positive.statement: The spacious eastern green area, fruit-tree theme, path extensions, and informal play areas are appropriately retained or developed.

position.target: eastern green area and informal play areas
position.rationale: Open eastern area lies beside the rectangular mass, with landscape use inferred from unbuilt space.

positive.statement: The generous access axis, guided by zenithal daylight, promises a high-quality meeting place that supports identification with the technical school while respecting the existing main building.

position.rationale: Central alignment between upper workshop and lower forum approximates the meeting-place access axis.

positive.statement: The well-sized training and workshop rooms are well lit through atriums.

position.rationale: Rooms are inferred within the visible rectangular workshop envelope; atriums are not separately distinguishable.

positive.statement: The typology of the workshop building fits the town crown and is developed from its context.

position.rationale: The elongated rectangular mass is clearly identifiable across plan and elevations.

negative.statement: The forum's form and size occupy the open space so extensively that the intended public center is only partially recognizable.

position.rationale: Distinct trapezoidal lower footprint visibly occupies a substantial open-space portion.

negative.statement: The generous paved piazza seems somewhat artificial, and its necessity and significance are doubted.

position.rationale: Open apron around the lower trapezoidal element is the plausible piazza location.

negative.statement: There is no understandable connection from the piazza to the existing technical center, and the historical context is treated only rudimentarily.

position.target: piazza connection to existing technical center
position.rationale: The interstitial alignment between the two masses approximates the questioned connection.

negative.statement: The planting concept remains too reserved to strengthen the integration of the buildings into the surroundings.

position.rationale: Eastern perimeter open space is the likely planting integration zone.

negative.statement: Additional corridors to the classrooms compete strongly with the central axis.

position.rationale: Corridors are not distinct, so the central workshop interior is used as a constrained proxy.

negative.statement: The column-free forum has no reference to the sports hall below and therefore raises questions about the supporting structure.

position.target: column-free forum and sports hall relationship
position.rationale: Lower forum footprint is visible, but supporting structure and sports hall reference are unresolved.

negative.statement: The uses are mostly functional but not optimally organized, and the space for the flow of goods is too limited.

position.rationale: A constrained service-zone estimate is placed near the workshop’s western edge.

negative.statement: The city-facing facade appears artificial, while the interaction between the two facade languages appears arbitrary.

position.rationale: The upper long edge is used as the likely city-facing facade, though orientation is not independently distinguishable.

negative.statement: The overall effect of the project is therefore not convincing.

position.rationale: Overall judgment is anchored to the combined rectangular workshop and trapezoidal forum composition.
